newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $1.00 higher than last Thursday.

Inquiry and demand were good. Sales confirmed on 52,700 slaughter steers and 28,300 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 92,700 head confirmed including 11,600 head or about 13 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.

Steers - select and choice 2-3 1025-1300 lbs, mostly 1100-1200 lbs 68.00; select with end choice 975-1300 lbs, including few cutting bulls 67.00; few Select and Choice 1100-1200 Holsteins 60.00-62.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 975-1175 lbs, mostly 1025-1075 lbs 68.00; select with end choice 67.00; pen mostly select 1060 lbs 66.00.
week to date: 92700 last week: 69200 last year: 26500
